messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate on /v1/generate - variant=edge-alpha-v2. p95 latency rising 1.8s -> 4.9s, errors up ~12% over baseline. Affected customer keys: c-omega, c-zen. Pager: sylvia-oncall

sylvia-oncall: I got the page, taking it. @bob-sre you're on deck for infra. Brief status in thread pls.

alice-eng: seeing tail latencies spike and repeated OOM evictions on some pods. Logs: 'cuda out of memory' + KV cache miss storm.

bob-sre: checking node health and GPU mem. If variant is flapping we should demote and route to stable-2.1. Also recommend lowering concurrency/backpressure.

carol-pm: customer impact: a few enterprise customers report timeouts for generation calls. SEs standing by for comms if we throttle.

sylvia-oncall: Proposed live mitigations: 1) soft rate-limit heavy keys (c-omega, c-zen) to 10rps 2) remove edge-alpha-v2 from routing and pin to stable-2.1 as fallback 3) apply emergency quota-slice at 60% for non-enterprise keys 4) keep priority-tagged requests. Executing now in that order.

dave-ops: preparing routing change. Commands I'm going to run:```
redwoodctl routing update --remove-variant edge-alpha-v2 --fallback stable-2.1 --dry-run
redwoodctl quotas update --slice emergency --percent 60
```

ops-bot: dry-run OK. Ready to apply when you confirm with `apply`.

sylvia-oncall: apply.

ops-bot: Applied routing change: edge-alpha-v2 removed from active pool; traffic rerouted to stable-2.1. Quota slice 60% applied to all non-enterprise keys. Soft rate limit for c-omega/c-zen set to 10rps.

alice-eng: Observability update: errors fell to ~3.2% within 60s, p95 back to ~1.2s. Stable-2.1 saw CPU/GPU utilization bump but within SLA.

bob-sre: eviction & oom metrics improved, no new OOMs. Monitoring autoscale for stable cluster, adjusting threshold if needed.

carol-pm: SEs notified affected accounts. Drafted customer note for transparency. ETA to restore edge variant?

sylvia-oncall: We'll keep edge-alpha-v2 disabled until we can run a constrained canary: reduced concurrency + adjusted memory settings. If canary stable, gradual re-enable with weighted traffic. Will update in 1h. For now paging resolved.

eva-support: Filed incident ticket INC-2026-873 and linked customer cases. Triage notes + impact matrix added.

sylvia-oncall: Thanks team :thumbsup: Passing soft handoff to night oncall in 45m. Please add this to the postmortem if edge stays disabled.

ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Labels: routing-change, quota-slice, pager-handled. Alert closed.
